rows.en:
(Still, I was surprised...
Who'd have thought Ranka's singing
would actually work on the Vajra...)

(Maybe this'll make the fighting ahead
a little easier...)

Damn it!
Ranka's singing, used as a tool of war...!
Major Ozma...

(Ranka doesn't sing
for the sake of fighting...)

(Yeah...
I have to keep protecting Ranka, no matter what!)

(I wasn't much use
as Ranka-chan's escort...)

(Phew... Somehow I managed to do my job
as Ranka-chan's escort.)

(Still, I was surprised...
Who'd have thought Ranka-chan's singing
would actually work on the Vajra...)

Argh!
Ranka's singing, used as a tool of war...!

(Ranka-chan doesn't sing
for the sake of fighting...)

(Yeah...
I have to keep protecting Ranka-chan,
no matter what!)

(Major Ozma was wounded in the last battle...
If we keep on fighting the Vajra like this,
we're bound to...)
rows.notes: Trails off as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
Who'd have thought the Vajra would show up
right before the super-long-distance fold...
rows.notes: Michel. Choukyori fold = 'super-long-distance fold' as in mission text u3011.

rows.en:
Why now, of all times...
My plan is ruined!

Griping about it here won't get us anywhere.
We're heading out!

(Major Ozma was wounded in the last battle...
If we keep on fighting the Vajra like this,
we're bound to...)

(Damn it! There's no point staying here!
I need to get to the S.M.S. base and grab
a weapon!)
(Somehow I made it to the hangar...)

(But the Vajra are still running wild in the city.
I need to sortie, fast!)

(Why are there Vajra inside the ship!? Weren't
we supposed to have escaped them with the
super-long-distance fold!?)

(Ugh! There's no point staying here!
I need to get to the S.M.S. base and grab
a weapon!)
(Somehow I made it to the hangar...)

(But the Vajra are still running wild in the city.
I need to sortie, fast!)

(The Vajra nearly got me,
but it looks like I somehow survived...)

(Looks like we somehow managed
to wipe out the Vajra...)
Alto! And Luca, you're safe too!

Yes. I'm so glad you're safe too,
\p-san...

Just barely...
But how did the Vajra get inside the ship?
They might have been breeding inside the Island...
Because of those Vajra, Michel...!
rows.notes: Alto; trails off as in the Japanese.

rows.en: Michel? What happened to Michel!?
Don't tell me......
He was trying to protect Klan...
No... That can't be true......

(Michel... no......
How... how could this happen...!)

(The Vajra nearly got me,
but it looks like I somehow survived...)

(Looks like we somehow managed
to wipe out the Vajra...)
Saotome-kun! And Luca-kun, you're safe too!
Michel-kun? What happened to Michel-kun!?
No... That can't be true......

(Michel-kun... no......
How... how could this happen...!)

(The ship's in ruins, and the ecosystem can't be
sustained anymore... In a situation like this...
what are we supposed to do...?)

(An order from our owner, Mr. Bilrer, to dissolve
S.M.S. and fold it into the New U.N. Forces...)
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Birura-shi: glossary 'Richard Bilrer' is status needs_check (wiki says Birler); 'Mr.' for -shi.

rows.en:
(Captain Jeffrey and the others didn't trust such
a sudden order, so I deserted Frontier with them
to find out the truth, but...)
rows.notes: The distrust belongs to Jeffrey and co. (modifier on Jeffrey-kanchou-tachi); the player deserted with them.

rows.en:
(I never imagined a truth like this
was waiting for us......)

So you're saying Grace is using fold quartz
and the Vajra to bring all of humanity
under her control.
Yeah, that's the size of it.

(Even the Vajra, who we thought were behind
it all, were just being used by Grace...)

Ruling the galaxy...
I figured it was some kind of joke,
but it looks like they're dead serious.

And the key to it all is the one
human who has a way to communicate
with the Vajra...
Ranka......

Right now, they're heading for the planet where
the Queen, the heart of the Vajra, resides.
rows.notes: Joou = Queen (Vajra Queen in mission text).

rows.en:
Which means we can't just let them
have things their way, hmm?
Exactly!

We're heading to the Vajra planet too,
and we're going to crush Grace's ambitions!

(Controlling people's minds
to take the galaxy for herself...)

(I'm not letting Grace have her way!
I'm going to rescue Ranka, no matter what!)

(I won't let Grace have her way!
I'm going to rescue Ranka-chan, no matter what!)

(Oh, that's right. Isn't Hilda-sensei holding
a special extra lesson later today?)
rows.notes: Trial course start. Hoshuu = 'Extra Lesson' (event title u0163).

rows.en:
(Today's extra lesson covers
'Shooting Moves' and 'Melee Moves'...)
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Kihon dousa = 'Basic Moves' (c23893); shageki/kakutou dousa follow suit.

rows.en:
(Attendance is optional,
so I don't have to go, right?)
(Hmm, what should I do?)

This extra lesson is a tutorial
on the Basic Moves of the EX-Gear.
rows.notes: Commentary (system narrator) to the real player.

rows.en:
If you don't know the controls or aren't confident
yet, please attend the extra lesson
and master them.

If you already understand the controls and feel
confident, there's no need to attend.
Attend the extra lesson
Skip the extra lesson

(Yeah, the basics matter in everything.
I'll go to the lesson and master them properly.)

All right, let's get right to it.
The extra lesson starts now.

As I announced, today's topic is the basics
of EX-Gear 'Shooting Moves'
and 'Melee Moves.'
Now, let's begin!

(Yeah, I've got the Basic Moves down,
so I think I can skip the extra lesson.)

(Okay, maybe I'll stop by Nyan-Nyan
on the way home.)

(Oh, that's right. Isn't Hilda-sensei holding
a special extra lesson later today?)

(Attendance is optional,
so I don't have to go, right?)
(Hmm, what should I do?)

(Yeah, the basics matter in everything.
I'll go to the lesson and master them properly.)

All right, that's it for today!
Everything I taught you this time
is the bare basics of EX-Gear movement.

But without the basics, there's no applying them!
Mastering what you learned today is the surest
shortcut to getting better.
